entities.name: Web3D Consortium
entities.note: The non-profit organization that develops and maintains the X3D, VRML, and H-Anim standards.

entities.name: ISO/IEC JTC 1/SC 24
entities.note: The ISO/IEC subcommittee responsible for standardization of computer graphics, image processing, and environmental data representation.

entities.name: W3C
entities.note: The World Wide Web Consortium, which standardizes HTML5 and other web technologies integrated with X3D.

entities.name: Khronos Group
entities.note: The consortium responsible for the glTF standard, which is interoperable with X3D 4.0.

entities.name: X3D Working Group
entities.note: The primary working group within the Web3D Consortium responsible for developing the X3D specification.

entities.name: H-Anim Working Group
entities.note: The working group focused on the Humanoid Animation (H-Anim) standard for representing humanoids in 3D.

entities.name: Medical Working Group
entities.note: A Web3D Consortium working group focused on using X3D for medical imaging and records.

entities.name: VRML97
entities.note: The Virtual Reality Modeling Language standard (ISO/IEC 14772) which preceded X3D.

entities.name: X3D
entities.note: The Extensible 3D Graphics standard, an open, royalty-free standard for 3D graphics on the web.

entities.name: X3D 3.0
entities.note: The initial major release of the X3D standard, transitioning from VRML97.

entities.name: X3D 3.3
entities.note: A widely adopted version of the X3D standard that introduced new nodes and capabilities before the 4.0 architecture.

entities.name: X3D 4.0
entities.note: The major architectural update to X3D featuring deep HTML5 integration and Physically Based Rendering (PBR).

entities.name: X3D 4.1
entities.note: An incremental update milestone for X3D focusing on further enhancements to the 4.0 architecture.

entities.name: H-Anim
entities.note: The Humanoid Animation standard for representing 3D human figures and their skeletal structures.

entities.name: glTF
entities.note: The GL Transmission Format, an API-neutral runtime asset delivery format supported natively in X3D 4.0.

entities.name: ISO/IEC 19775-1
entities.note: The ISO specification defining the X3D Architecture and base components.

entities.name: ISO/IEC 19775-2
entities.note: The ISO specification defining the X3D Scene Access Interface (SAI).

entities.name: ISO/IEC 19776-1
entities.note: The ISO specification defining the X3D XML Encoding.

entities.name: ISO/IEC 19776-2
entities.note: The ISO specification defining the X3D ClassicVRML Encoding.

entities.name: ISO/IEC 19776-3
entities.note: The ISO specification defining the X3D Compressed Binary Encoding.

entities.name: ISO/IEC 19777-1
entities.note: The ISO specification defining the X3D ECMAScript (JavaScript) language binding.

entities.name: ISO/IEC 19777-2
entities.note: The ISO specification defining the X3D Java language binding.

entities.name: ISO/IEC 19774
entities.note: The ISO specification defining the H-Anim humanoid animation standard.

entities.name: XML Encoding
entities.note: The .x3d file format encoding based on the Extensible Markup Language.

entities.name: ClassicVRML Encoding
entities.note: The .x3dv file format encoding which retains the syntax style of VRML97.

entities.name: Compressed Binary Encoding
entities.note: The .x3db file format encoding designed for fast transmission and parsing.

entities.name: JSON Encoding
entities.note: An alternative encoding for X3D scenes using JavaScript Object Notation.

entities.name: HTML5 Integration
entities.note: The guidelines and DOM integration features allowing X3D to be embedded directly in HTML5 pages.

entities.name: Scene Access Interface
entities.note: The API allowing external applications and internal scripts to interact with the X3D scene graph.

entities.name: ECMAScript Binding
entities.note: The standard mapping of the X3D Scene Access Interface to JavaScript.

entities.name: Java Binding
entities.note: The standard mapping of the X3D Scene Access Interface to the Java programming language.

entities.name: Don Brutzman
entities.note: A key architect and long-time co-chair of the X3D Working Group.

entities.name: Dick Puk
entities.note: A primary specification editor for X3D and ISO standards expert.

entities.name: Nicholas Polys
entities.note: President of the Web3D Consortium and active contributor to X3D specifications.

entities.name: X3D Validator
entities.note: A suite of tools provided by the Web3D Consortium to check X3D scenes for standard compliance.

entities.name: X3D-Edit
entities.note: An open-source authoring tool for creating and editing X3D scenes, maintained by the Web3D Consortium.
